introHtml: Large work pants ensure a comfortable fit for employees who need room to move without excess fabric. Whether you are outfitting a maintenance crew or a healthcare team, large sizes accommodate a range of body types while maintaining a professional appearance. Polyester-cotton blends offer durability for daily wear, and features like reinforced knees or cargo pockets add functionality. Customize with embroidery or screen printing for a cohesive uniform look.
